name: core.openwop.workflows.commerce
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0152) — the Commerce operations cluster (ecommerce gap plan §5C C8): Post-Purchase Thank-You, Low-Stock Reorder Draft, and the Order Exception Digest. Designed to bind to the ADR 0221 host events (host.commerce.order.paid, host.commerce.inventory.low-stock — create a host-event binding to enroll; ADR 0208) or the schedule trigger. Every outbound send rides the governed email-send integration node (drafts/approval per the tenant's actionPolicy — ADR 0033) and the ONE notification seam; order data flows through feature.commerce.nodes over ctx.features.commerce, so the ADR 0221 audit rows + spend thresholds apply by construction. Enrollment state = the run itself; a binding fires one run per event.
author: openwop

chains.label: Post-Purchase Thank-You
chains.description: On order paid (bind to host.commerce.order.paid): read the order, AI-compose a grounded thank-you, human sign-off, then the governed email-send (compose output flows to send via the edge — the corpus convention; the tenant actionPolicy decides draft-vs-send, the ADR 0193 ledger dedups re-fires).

orderId.description: The paid order (from the trigger payload when event-bound).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

config.systemPrompt: Write a short post-purchase thank-you email for this order (tone: {{params.tone}}). Ground every detail in the order data; never invent items or amounts.

config.title: Approve this thank-you email before it is sent

chains.label: Low-Stock Reorder Draft
chains.description: On a low-stock crossing (bind to host.commerce.inventory.low-stock): read catalog context, draft a supplier reorder email, hold it at a purchasing sign-off gate, then send + notify the owner (draft content flows to the send/notify nodes via edges — the corpus convention). Never mutates inventory.

productId.description: The low product (from the trigger payload when event-bound).

supplierHint.description: Optional supplier name/email to address the draft to.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

chains.label: Order Exception Digest
chains.description: On a schedule (pair with core.trigger.schedule): list orders, AI-summarize the exceptions — paid-but-unfulfilled beyond the SLA, aging pending reservations — and push the summary to the operations inbox (the digest node's output flows to the notification via the edge, the corpus convention). Read-only; escalation stays human.
